kernel: the gated-DeltaNet kernels: fused prep (conv1d + SiLU + q/k L2 norm + decay/beta), the recurrence with gated RMSNorm (decode gdn_step, token-parallel prefill gdn_prep_par / gdn_step_parr* / gdn_gnorm), and the verify forms (verify.metal gdn_prep_verify / gdn_step_verify, verify8.metal gdn_step_verify8s + gdn_gnorm_x8) that tape pending rows and fold them in the next pass
summary: Kapitsa's gated-DeltaNet path for the Qwen linear-attention families (dense qwen3_5, qwen3_5_moe, and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). Decode dispatches gdn_prep over 128-channel chunks and then one threadgroup of 1024 threads per value head; token-parallel prefill (default on) uses gdn_step_parr4_l16 with 4 interleaved value rows per lane. Verify tapes k, g and the scalar delta of each row and folds the previous cycle's accepted rows into the state at the start of the next verify pass or encode_flush; the 8-row verify splits each head over value-row blocks with a per-head arrival counter.

settings.name: gdn_head_dim

settings.name: decode_prep_grid
settings.value: C/128 threadgroups x 128 threads, C = 2*Hk*Dk + Hv*Dv; one threadgroup per 128-channel head chunk

settings.name: decode_step_grid
settings.value: one threadgroup per value head: grid x = Hv

settings.name: state_dtype
settings.value: fp32

settings.name: state_layout
settings.value: [Hv, Dv=128, Dk=128] per layer; simdgroup sg owns rows dv = sg*4..sg*4+3 and lane owns dk = lane*4..lane*4+3 as float4

settings.name: state_bytes_per_head
settings.condition: always (Hv * Dv * Dk * 4 allocated per linear layer)

settings.name: conv_state_rows
settings.condition: always (previous 3 raw qkv inputs per channel)

settings.name: conv_state_layout
settings.value: [3, C] fp32 raw inputs; concat = [state rows 0..2, qkv rows]; after the pass rolled to concat[T..T+2] reading rows in ascending order

settings.name: qk_norm_eps
settings.condition: always (rsqrt of sum of squares over the 128-channel chunk plus eps)

settings.name: q_post_norm_scale
settings.condition: always (q only; applied after the L2 norm)

settings.name: fused_prep_stages
settings.value: conv1d + SiLU + q/k L2 norm + decay g (exp(-A*softplus(a + dt_bias))) + beta (sigmoid(b)) in one kernel

settings.name: gated_norm_eps
settings.value: model config eps, passed via GdnStepParams.eps

settings.name: gate_activation
settings.value: silu for the qwen3_5 families; sigmoid for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (output_gate_type)

settings.name: prefill_step_kernel
settings.value: gdn_step_parr4_l16 (NI_GDN_STEP default: 16 lanes per row, 4 interleaved value rows per lane)
settings.condition: always (NI_GDN_PAR=0 falls back to per-channel gdn_prep/gdn_step)

settings.name: prefill_prep_grid
settings.value: ((T+31)/32, C/128 + 1) threadgroups x 128 threads; one simdgroup per 8 tokens x 128 channels, the extra y row computes g/beta

settings.name: prefill_prep_tokens_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: always (TB = 8; 4 simdgroups per threadgroup give 32 tokens)

settings.name: prefill_step_grid
settings.value: Hv * (128/rows_tg) threadgroups x 32*sgs threads

settings.name: prefill_gnorm_grid
settings.value: ceil(T*Hv/8) threadgroups x 256 threads; one simdgroup per (token, head)

settings.name: gnorm_output_dtype
settings.value: half in the par-prefill (gdn_gnorm) and verify8 (gdn_gnorm_x8) epilogues; decode gdn_step keeps fp32 into out_proj

settings.name: verify_prep_grid
settings.value: C/128 threadgroups x 128 threads (as gdn_prep)

settings.name: verify_step_grid
settings.value: Hv threadgroups x 1024 threads (as gdn_step)

settings.name: verify_tape_layout
settings.value: pend_k [Rmax, Hv, 128] fp32; pend_g [Rmax, Hv] fp32; pend_d [Rmax, Hv, 128] fp32, one scalar delta per value row (also pend_qkv [Rmax, C] fp32)

settings.name: verify_fold_mode
settings.value: the previous cycle's accepted rows are folded from the tape into the state at the start of the next verify pass (or encode_flush), then a mem_device barrier before the tape is overwritten
settings.condition: always (n_pend rows; tree cycles fold via path indices)

settings.name: verify8_split_threadgroup_size
settings.condition: always (V8Knobs gdnsplit default; 0 would mean one threadgroup per head)

settings.name: verify8_split_grid
settings.value: (Hv, 128/(split_thr/8)) x split_thr threads, i.e. (Hv, 16) x 256 at the default

settings.name: verify8_counter_sync
settings.value: per-head atomic arrival counter cnt[h]; the last block of a head writes the next k/g tape rows and resets the counter

settings.name: verify8_update_form
settings.value: fma(k, delta, st*g) as one explicit gdn_update so step, fold and tree replay round identically

gates.condition: prefill par layout: rows_tg != 0, 32 % lanes == 0, 128 % rows_tg == 0, sgs <= 32, else fatal

verify8 split: NI_V8_GDN != 0 and lin_dv == 128 and lin_dk == 128 and 32 <= split_thr <= 1024 and split_thr % 32 == 0 and 128 % (split_thr/8) == 0; else the unsplit gdn_step_verify8/gdn_step_verify at Hv x 1024
KFlash tree verify requires the split form (fatal otherwise)
R >= v8_rows_min() routes verify to the 8-row path: NI_V8=1 gives 2, NI_V8=0 or MoE gives 5, dense default 3

notes: Doc-vs-source: (1) our KAPITSA_KERNELS.md groups Nemotron with the GDN families, but kapitsa's gdn.metal serves only the Qwen linear-attention family; kapitsa's Nemotron hybrid models run their own Mamba2-style SSD kernels (nh_ssd.metal, head_dim 64, d_state 128). (2) Item 9's '(32,4) delta layout contract' that the fused prep would break is our contract; kapitsa's source shows no such constraint, its fused prep (gdn_prep) is exactly the declined fusion, and its verify delta tape is one fp32 scalar per value row, not a (32,4) float4 layout. (3) The 'one threadgroup per head' decode claim is confirmed (src/model/qwen35.cpp:2093). (4) Item 1's alternative is confirmed: the small-batch verify folds the previous cycle's accepted rows at the start of the next verify pass (src/kernels/verify.metal:528) or in encode_flush, i.e. the state fold lives in the next kernel. Caveats the repo records: the fast-math reassociation makes the par prefill path agree with the per-channel path only to rounding by default, bit-identical only under NI_MATH_SAFE=1 (src/kernels/gdn.metal:164); the 35B router top-k can flip on a last-bit state difference between trees, which is why gdn_update pins the update as one FMA (src/kernels/verify8.metal:2165); the kernels take runtime param structs with no function-constant shape baking, matching our doc's shape-baking advantage row. Kapitsa's decode gated norm stays fused in gdn_step with fp32 output; the half output only appears in the par-prefill and verify8 epilogues. The prefill recurrence A/B in gdn.metal names no machine or date.
